about: Effects fixes for converted presets (applied by tools/cut_more.py after the conversion), raw knob numbers: delay_send and reverb_send (0-127), delay (the DELAY page's eight values MODE TIME FEEDBACK TONE SPREAD MOD HPF RETURN). 2026-10-28: Dotted Chords had its delay send at 111 (nearly full), now the delay of Detroit Seq (content/techno): send 28, dotted eighth, feedback about 45%.
